title: Hire Us
desc: If you need one expert consultant or a whole product team to ensure a successful launch, Humblebee provide the right designers, engineers and more for your needs.
html:
How to work with us

One expert or a full team. You choose.

Expert Consultants
Need additional capability? Bring in experienced designers, software engineers and product specialists who can strengthen your team from day one.
Project Team
Need something built? A cross-functional Humblebee team takes ownership. From strategy and design to engineering and launch.
CoVenture Team
Looking for your next advantage? Partner with us to discover, validate and launch new ventures with shared ambition and shared commitment.

Why clients choose Humblebee consultants

We're far more than extra capacity, our people create momentum from day one.
We speak fluent industry
Our consultants have worked across manufacturing, mobility, industrial platforms, aftermarket, service operations and complex B2B organisations. We spend less time learning your business and more time creating value.
Commercial minds and technical skills
Our consultants understand products, customers and business, not just UX design or code. Every decision is made with commercial impact in mind.
Hit the ground running
Our team are used to working in complex industrial organisations with multiple stakeholders. This background makes us well used to the necessity of being onboarded and up and running quickly.  
AI for faster delivery, higher quality
We use modern AI-assisted workflows where they genuinely improve speed, quality and efficiency. Allowing our teams to spend more time solving the right problems.
Better together
Our Bee's collaborate naturally across design, engineering, product and leadership. We're trained in design thinking methodologies that often benefit the client teams we join and help projects flow.
Trusted by complex organisations
We're comfortable where others struggle. Enterprise platforms. Multiple stakeholders. Legacy systems. Long product lifecycles. Our consultants are used to navigating the complexity that defines industrial organisations.

Get in touch

Whether you need one expert or an entire product team, we'll help you find the right people for your next initiative.
